description: Retrieve live network-wide Ad-o-matic pool metrics and Genesis Member slot availability (first 50 store-verified apps receive permanent founding priority, max 3 per developer). Read-only; takes no parameters and never mutates state. Returns genesisSpotsTotal, genesisSpotsClaimed, genesisSpotsRemaining, maxGenesisSpotsPerDeveloper, registeredAppsCount, distinctDeveloperGroups, bannerTestPeriodDays, and genesisMembers. Usage: call to check overall network health, active peer count, or open Genesis slots before onboarding. To inspect a specific app's integration checklist, call adomatic_verify_integration instead.
name: adomatic_network_status
